name: ZA-TS Mounted Spreader
tagline: Pure precision from one spreading unit. Highly efficient on a large scale - and yet precise right up to the field boundary.
description: Professional fertilisation with high work rates while avoiding over-fertilisation and protecting the environment. The ZA-TS mounted spreader delivers reliable application even in windy conditions or when fertiliser quality is poor, using the TS spreading system for excellent border spread patterns up to 54 m working widths.
specs: Working width: 15 m to 54 m
Hopper capacity: 1,400 l to 5,000 l
Application rate: up to 650 kg/min
Spreading disc drive: mechanical or hydraulic
Border spreading settings: 16 or 128 positions
TS spreader unit with excellent border spread patterns
AutoTS and BorderTS border spreading systems
ProfisPro rate calibration for accurate application from the first second
HeadlandControl for uniform yield across the headland with optimised Section Control
WindControl automatic wind compensation via high-frequency sensors
ArgusTwin permanent spread fan monitoring for optimum lateral distribution
ISOBUS compatible

name: ZG-TX Trailed Combi Spreader
tagline: AMAZONE sets new standards in the combi spreader sector.
description: Both granular mineral fertilisers and earth-moist limes can be applied precisely through the one machine by means of a simple conversion between the TS spreading system and the newly developed spreading unit for lime. Quicker and easier conversion between lime and fertiliser spreading with outstanding lateral distribution thanks to the tried-and-tested TS spreading system.
specs: Working width: 15 m to 54 m
Hopper capacity: 6,800 l to 11,200 l
Boom options: 1, 2, or 16
Spreader disc drive: mechanical
Control systems: EasySet 2 in-cab terminal or ISOBUS
FlowControl for precise application rates from the first second
HeadlandControl for perfect lateral distribution through wider spreading
AutoTS for fertiliser and border spread deflector for lime
Maximum capacity suited to larger working widths

name: ZA-M Centrifugal Fertiliser Spreader
tagline: The ideal machine for both farmers and contractors alike.
description: A twin disc centrifugal fertiliser spreader that places great emphasis on safety and reliability, featuring slow-turning, heavy-duty agitators and low disc speed to ensure an even, granule-protecting fertiliser flow.
specs: Hopper capacity: up to 3,000 l
Spreading width: up to 36 m
Double-tipped hopper design with optimum shape for continuous flow monitoring
Complete stainless steel spreading system construction
Twin disc drive with reduced speeds
Slow-turning, high-capacity agitation system
Fine-mesh filling sieves, foldable and lockable
Double shutter system for rate adjustment
Standard lighting system, warning signs, and safety bracket

name: ZA-V Mounted Spreader
tagline: Hopper capacity of 1,400 to 4,200 l, reaching impressively high working speeds of up to 30 km/h.
description: An ultra-modern fertiliser spreader featuring ISOBUS communication, an integrated weighing system, and hydraulic or electric border spreading capabilities, designed for efficient, high-capacity application with intuitive operation and durable construction.
specs: Hopper capacity: 1,400 - 4,200 l
Working width: 15 - 36 m
Working speed: up to 30 km/h
Application rate: up to 390 kg/min
Spreader unit options: 2, 6, 8, or 16 outlets
Spreader drive: mechanical or hydraulic
Control options: hydraulic shutter actuation, EasySet 2, AmaSpread 2, ISOBUS
200 Hz Profis weighing system for precise application
Deep-drawn, seamless base hopper
Electric Limiter V+ border spreading technology
QuickSet blade adjustment
Cathodic dip priming and powder coating for durability

name: ZA-X Perfect Mounted Spreader
tagline: Twin disc centrifugal spreader for smaller and medium-sized farming or grassland farms.
description: Engineered for precise spreading of all commercially available fertiliser types up to 18 m and urea up to 15 m. Designed with user convenience in mind, featuring straightforward adjustment mechanisms and reliable performance across various fertiliser applications.
specs: Spread width: up to 18 m (standard fertilisers); 15 m (urea)
Double-tipped hopper design with optimum shape for continuous flow monitoring
Complete spreading system manufactured from stainless steel
Fine-mesh filling sieves that fold up and lock for accessible cleaning
Double shutter system for precise rate adjustment and rapid opening/closing

name: ZA-TS 01 AutoSpread Mounted Spreader
tagline: The self-adjusting spreader that revolutionises fertiliser spreading.
description: Features an autonomous AutoSpread system that monitors actual spread patterns and automatically adjusts spreader settings for optimum distribution, offering new standards in precision and automation with intelligent online connectivity and continuous validation capabilities.
specs: Working width: 15 m to 54 m
Hopper capacity: 4,200 l to 5,000 l
Spreading vanes: 128
Spreader adjustment: autonomous via AutoSpread
Automatic adjustment based on measurement of actual spread patterns

mySpreader App for simplified operation and centralized spreading information

name: ZG-TS Trailed Spreader
description: A trailed fertiliser spreader engineered for large-scale operations requiring both efficiency and precision, delivering reliable application even in windy conditions or when fertiliser quality is poor, and maintaining accuracy right up to the field boundary.
specs: Working width: 15 - 54 m
Hopper capacity: 7,500 - 10,000 l
Application rate: up to 650 kg/min
